facts.fact: A one-year Remote Sensing Agricultural Services Agreement worth US$2.4 million took effect on 16 June 2026 to build a national crop-monitoring system using satellite imagery to map agricultural land, monitor crop and pasture health and forecast staple crop production, before Cabinet ordered it cancelled.

systems.platform: satellite imagery, geospatial analysis and AI
systems.owner: Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Water and Land Reform
